title: Totem Flight
description: Fly using a Totem of Undying with modern, animated particle effects.
body:
### <iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/csj3VAPuuXU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>Totem Flight

Totem Flight allows players to **fly while holding a Totem of Undying in their off-hand**.

Designed with a **modern visual style**, the mod adds:
- Directional flight effects
- Animated aura in third person
- Clean white and gray particle trails
- Lightweight and server-friendly logic

### Features
- No commands required
- Flight enabled only when holding a Totem
- No client-side hacks
- Fully server-side compatible
- Works in multiplayer
- No configuration required

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.5
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

### Notes
- Does not affect Creative or Spectator mode
- Designed to be performance-friendly
